balance.solved: Balanced! On every beam, mass × arm on the left equals mass × arm on the right.
balance.stillBad: Beams still out of balance: {bad}. Compare mass × arm on both sides of the pivot.
balance.hint: Tap a beam or a weight to choose it; drag to move it.
balance.title: Balance — workshop
balance.says: A world of things: beams and weights that you hang, move and change; each beam computes its moment and tilts until you balance it.
balance.alt: A balance of beams and weights — workshop
balance.predict: The world stands still: build or change what you like and predict what will happen — then “Check”.
balance.workshopHint: Tap a beam to hang a weight or another beam on it; drag a weight along the beam. Undo: Ctrl+Z.

gears.title: Gear train
gears.says: Gears as a world of things: each gear meshes with the gear it hangs on; the number of teeth decides the speed. Add a gear, change the teeth, drag it around its neighbour.
gears.alt: A gear train: the driving gear and the gears meshing with it
gears.hint: Tap a gear: change its number of teeth or add the next one. Drag a gear around its neighbour.

projectile.title: Projectile motion
projectile.says: Angle and speed, a short sight, the flight trail, a draggable target; hitting it is the goal of the task.
projectile.alt: Projectile motion: angle and speed decide where the ball lands
projectile.short: Short by {fmt(cel - x, 1)} m. The longest flight is at an angle of 45°.
projectile.dragArrow: Direction and speed — drag the arrowhead
projectile.caption: angle {fmt(kat, 0)}° · speed {fmt(v0, 1)} m/s

pendulum.title: Pendulum
pendulum.says: A draggable bob (deflection and length), Earth / Mars / Moon, the period from the formula and a trail.
pendulum.alt: Pendulum: the period depends on length and gravity

spring.title: Oscillation on a spring
spring.says: A block to pull out, stiffness, mass, damping; an x(t) graph and energy bars.
spring.alt: A block on a spring: oscillation and exchange of energy

incline.title: Inclined plane with friction
incline.says: Slope, friction, forces as arrows; the block starts only when tan α > μ.
incline.alt: Inclined plane: the forces acting on the block
incline.stays: The block stays: friction μ·cos α is at least sin α (tan α ≤ μ).
incline.slides: The block slides down with an acceleration of {fmt(a, 2)} m/s².

collision.title: Collision of carts
collision.says: Masses, speed, elasticity; momentum stays the same, energy — only at e = 1.
collision.alt: Collision of two carts on a track
collision.hit: Collision! Momentum before and after: {fmt(p, 2)} kg·m/s.

refraction.title: Refraction of light
refraction.says: A draggable source, media to choose; Snell’s law and total reflection.
refraction.alt: A ray of light at the boundary of two media
refraction.total: Total internal reflection: sin α₂ would come out greater than 1, so the light does not pass.
refraction.denser: Into a denser medium: the ray bends towards the normal.
refraction.thinner: Into a less dense medium: the ray bends away from the normal.
refraction.dragSource: Light source — drag along the arc

waves.title: Superposition of waves
waves.says: Two travelling waves and their sum; wavelength and phase shift; in a presentation the sum appears in the second step.

orbit.title: Orbit
orbit.says: The launch speed as a draggable arrow: too slow — it falls, just right — a circle, faster — an ellipse, too fast — it escapes.
orbit.alt: A satellite in orbit around a planet
orbit.fell: Too slow — the satellite fell onto the planet.
orbit.escape: Escape speed: √2 ≈ 1.41 times the circular speed — the satellite flies away.

ball.title: Bouncing ball
ball.says: Moves on its own from the start: the ball falls and bounces; drag it to change the height.
ball.alt: A ball falls and bounces off the ground
